'''The Obscura''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}. It summons a {{M2|Parafright}} at the start of the fight.

== The Obscura ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = The Obscura
|Image  = StS2_The Obscura.png
|HP     = 123
|AscHP  = 129
|Debut  = Hive
|Type   = Normal
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|The Obscura}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Illusion
|Intent = Summon
|Effect = Summons a {{M2|Parafright}}.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Piercing Gaze
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Wail
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = All enemies gain 3 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Hardening Strike
|Intent = Attack2, Defend
|Effect = Deals (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) damage. Gains (6;{{Asc2|9|7}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Obscura always opens with {{Int2|The Obscura|Illusion}} to summon a {{M2|Parafright}}. After that, it randomly picks one of three moves — {{Int2|The Obscura|Piercing Gaze}}, {{Int2|The Obscura|Wail}}, or {{Int2|The Obscura|Hardening Strike}} — and cannot use the same move twice in a row.

{{Clear}}

== Parafright ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Parafright
|Image  = StS2_Parafright.png
|HP     = 21
|Powers = {{BD2|Illusion}}
|Debut  = Hive
|Type   = Minion
}} {{Power Infobox|Illusion|2}}
The Parafright is a minion summoned by The Obscura via {{Int2|The Obscura|Illusion}}.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Parafright}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slam
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|17}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Parafright|Slam}} every turn.

{{Clear}}
